newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Semiconductor ups stake in Vanguard.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Semiconductor ups stake in Vanguard.

text.p: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp, Taiwan's largest semiconductor maker, said on Saturday it bought 70 million shares of common stock in the island's Vanguard International Semiconductor Corp.
The shares, totalling T$1.05 billion, were bought at T$15 per share, a company statement said.
TSMC's stake in Vanguard would rise to 27.52 percent from 23.63 percent after the purchase, which would be settled by Setpember 20, it said.
Taiwan Semiconductor said it was confident about Vanguard's development and hoped the move would strengthen the two firms' long-term relationship.
